auth_details: API tokens (Basic auth with Atlassian email + token), OAuth 2.0, workspace/project/repo access tokens; app passwords retired (final removal July 28, 2026)
free_tier_limits: Free plan includes API access; default API rate limit 1,000 req/hour (shared across plans, not free-only). Product free: ~5 users, 1 GB storage, 50 build min/mo; higher rate limits for larger Standard/Premium workspaces with access tokens or Forge
paid_plans: Standard ~$3.65/user/mo; Premium ~$7.25/user/mo; scaled rate limits up to 10,000 req/hour for large Standard/Premium workspaces
rate_limits: Default 1,000 requests/hour; Standard/Premium with 100+ paid users and access tokens/Forge: 1,000 + (paid seats − 100) × 10, capped at 10,000/hour
description: Bitbucket Cloud REST API (v2.0) lets developers manage repositories, pull requests, pipelines, issues, and workspaces programmatically. Hosted at api.bitbucket.org; uses OAuth 2.0, API tokens, or access tokens. Free tier available with plan-based rate limits.
resolution_notes: auth.details: auditor right — app passwords fully retired July 28, 2026 (https://support.atlassian.com/bitbucket-cloud/docs/app-passwords/); rate_limits: auditor right — formula is 1,000 + (paid seats − 100) × 10, cap 10k (https://support.atlassian.com/bitbucket-cloud/docs/api-request-limits/).
